model_observation.scope: Actual omitted model overrides mean inherited session defaults; explicit experimental requests, where present, remain requests. The host does not expose authenticated resolved backend identities.

metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: Supplementary replacement attempt with disclosed actual-dispatch deviation. No exact first substantive action timestamp or authenticated native duration. Some interim child notifications lack verbatim contemporaneous exports; the summary file is not substituted for the actual terminal completion export. Native role binding, resolved model identities, usage and billing unavailable. Natural-time playback, broad plugin compatibility, full accessibility acceptance and physical mobile keyboards unverified. Date metadata remains low emphasis. Cross-call stale deleted .tid files were observed/retained and neutralized for final fresh store/export, while executor deletion anomaly remains unresolved. Producer/researcher claims are not independent final product acceptance.
registration_scope: Reference to the original registered cell; actual dispatch differs. This supplementary record is not an assertion of exact original-protocol execution.
prompt_identity_scope: run.prompt_sha256 identifies the frozen registered prompt only; actual dispatch differs and is retained in prompt_deviation. No byte-identical actual dispatch claim is made.
